# 26 GHz Communication Channel Dataset for Domain Shift Invariant Blockage Prediction

A measured 26 GHz OFDM CSI dataset covering multiple human blockage activities, collected on the KU Leuven mmWave/Massive-MIMO testbed for blockage prediction and domain-shift research.

### [Blockage Prediction](../tasks/blockage-prediction.md)

**Inputs:** Channel matrix

**Targets:** Blockage status

**Scope:** Predict human-induced mmWave blockage conditions from measured 26 GHz OFDM channel-state information.
